traditions.KJV: My breath is corrupt ,
my days are extinct ,

1.english_reference: the graves [ are ready ] for me

traditions.LXX: δέομαι δὲ ταφῆς καὶ οὐ τυγχάνω .
traditions.KJV: the graves [ are ready ] for me .

2.english_reference: [ Are there ] not mockers with me ?

traditions.KJV: [ Are there ] not mockers with me ?

2.english_reference: and doth not mine eye continue in their provocation ?

traditions.WLC: וּ֝ בְ הַמְּרוֹתָ֗ ם תָּלַ֥ן עֵינִֽ י
traditions.VUL: et in amaritudínibus morátur óculus meus .
traditions.KJV: and doth not mine eye continue in their provocation ?

3.english_reference: Lay down now , put me in a surety with thee

traditions.WLC: שִֽׂימָ ה נָּ֭א עָרְבֵ֣ נִי עִמָּ֑ ךְ
traditions.LXX: ἔκλεψαν δέ μου τὰ ὑπάρχοντα ἀλλότριοι ·
traditions.VUL: Líbera me Dómine , et pone me iuxta te ,
traditions.KJV: Lay down now , put me in a surety with thee ;

3.english_reference: who [ is ] he [ that ] will strike hands with me ?

traditions.WLC: מִֽי ה֝֗וּא לְ יָדִ֥ י יִתָּקֵֽעַ
traditions.LXX: τίς ἐστιν οὗτος ; τῇ χειρί μου συνδεθήτω .
traditions.VUL: et cuiúsvis manus pugnet contra me .
traditions.KJV: who [ is ] he [ that ] will strike hands with me ?

4.english_reference: For thou hast hid their heart from understanding

traditions.LXX: ὅτι καρδίαν αὐτῶν ἔκρυψας ἀπὸ φρονήσεως ,
traditions.VUL: Cor eórum longe fecísti a disciplína ,
traditions.KJV: For thou hast hid their heart from understanding :

4.english_reference: therefore shalt thou not exalt [ them ]

traditions.LXX: διὰ τοῦτο οὐ μὴ ὑψώσῃς αὐτούς .
traditions.KJV: therefore shalt thou not exalt [ them ] .

5.english_reference: He that speaketh flattery to [ his ] friends

traditions.KJV: He that speaketh flattery to [ his ] friends ,

5.english_reference: even the eyes of his children shall fail

traditions.KJV: even the eyes of his children shall fail .

6.english_reference: He hath made me also a byword of the people

traditions.WLC: וְֽ֭ הִצִּגַ נִי לִ מְשֹׁ֣ל עַמִּ֑ים
traditions.LXX: ἔθου δέ με θρύλημα ἐν ἔθνεσιν ,
traditions.VUL: Pósuit me quasi in provérbium vulgi ,
traditions.KJV: He hath made me also a byword of the people ;

6.english_reference: and aforetime I was as a tabret

traditions.KJV: and aforetime I was as a tabret .

7.english_reference: Mine eye also is dim by reason of sorrow

traditions.WLC: וַ תֵּ֣כַהּ מִ כַּ֣עַשׂ עֵינִ֑ י
traditions.LXX: πεπώρωνται γὰρ ἀπὸ ὀργῆς οἱ ὀφθαλμοί μου ,
traditions.KJV: Mine eye also is dim by reason of sorrow ,

traditions.WLC: וִֽ יצֻרַ֖ י כַּ צֵּ֣ל כֻּלָּֽ ם
traditions.VUL: et membra mea quasi in níhilum redácta sunt .
traditions.KJV: and all my members [ are ] as a shadow .

8.english_reference: Upright [ men ] shall be astonied at this

traditions.KJV: Upright [ men ] shall be astonied at this ,

8.english_reference: and the innocent shall stir up himself against the hypocrite

traditions.KJV: and the innocent shall stir up himself against the hypocrite .

traditions.LXX: σχοίη δὲ πιστὸς τὴν ἑαυτοῦ ὁδόν ,
traditions.KJV: The righteous also shall hold on his way ,

9.english_reference: and he that hath clean hands shall be stronger and stronger

traditions.KJV: and he that hath clean hands shall be stronger and stronger .

10.english_reference: But as for you all , do ye return

traditions.LXX: οὐ μὴν δὲ ἀλλὰ πάντες ἐρείδετε ,
traditions.KJV: But as for you all , do ye return ,
and come now :

10.english_reference: for I can not find [ one ] wise [ man ] among you

traditions.LXX: οὐ γὰρ εὑρίσκω ἐν ὑμῖν ἀληθές .
traditions.VUL: et non invéniam in vobis ullum sapiéntem .
traditions.KJV: for I can not find [ one ] wise [ man ] among you .
My days are past ,
my purposes are broken off , [ even ]

traditions.LXX: ἐρράγη δὲ τὰ ἄρθρα τῆς καρδίας μου ·
traditions.KJV: the thoughts of my heart .

12.english_reference: They change the night into day

traditions.KJV: They change the night into day :

12.english_reference: the light [ is ] short because of darkness

traditions.VUL: et rursum post ténebras spero lucem .
traditions.KJV: the light [ is ] short because of darkness .
If I wait ,
the grave [ is ] mine house :

13.english_reference: I have made my bed in the darkness

traditions.LXX: ἐν δὲ γνόφῳ ἔστρωταί μου ἡ στρωμνή .
traditions.VUL: et in ténebris stravi léctulum meum .
traditions.KJV: I have made my bed in the darkness .

14.english_reference: I have said to corruption , Thou [ art ] my father

traditions.KJV: I have said to corruption , Thou [ art ] my father :

traditions.WLC: אָ֑תָּה אִמִּ֥ י וַ֝ אֲחֹתִ֗ י לָֽ רִמָּֽה
traditions.LXX: μητέρα δέ μου καὶ ἀδελφὴν σαπρίαν .
traditions.VUL: mater mea , et soror mea , vérmibus .
traditions.KJV: to the worm , [ Thou art ] my mother , and my sister .

traditions.LXX: ποῦ οὖν μου ἔτι ἐστὶν ἡ ἐλπίς ;
traditions.VUL: Ubi est ergo nunc præstolátio mea ?
traditions.KJV: And where [ is ] now my hope ?

traditions.KJV: as for my hope , who shall see it ?

traditions.LXX: ἢ μετ᾽ ἐμοῦ εἰς ᾅδην καταβήσονται ,
traditions.VUL: In profundíssimum inférnum descéndent ómnia mea :
traditions.KJV: They shall go down to the bars of the pit ,

16.english_reference: when [ our ] rest together [ is ] in the dust

traditions.VUL: putásne saltem ibi erit réquies mihi ?
traditions.KJV: when [ our ] rest together [ is ] in the dust .
